column4: *To qualify for the EOL Finals: 1st Place in EOL Race - 6 spots in total / 1st Place in EOL Underground (Ride Hermes) - 1 spot in total / 2 Guaranteed Wildcard (qualification on the spot) - 2 spots in total / Remaining 23 spots will go to the highest ranked riders who are not qualified yet. If one or more rider(s) wins multiple spots throught Race and/or Underground wins, those spots will go to the next rider in the ranking until the 30th place maximum. If one or more of the 30 riders qualified can't go to the EOL Finals their place will go to a on the spot Wildcard!
Special thanks to Patrick Lopez for helping create this ranking
